items.title: SEC Staff Says Token Buybacks Don't Make Crypto a Security—If the Network Works
items.summary: New SEC staff guidance says announcing a token buyback on a functional network isn't a promise that turns the token into a security, a shift one attorney says makes securities laws look "opt-in."

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Notch Seven-Day Winning Streak as 2026 Flows Turn Green
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn nearly $3 billion over seven straight sessions, erasing post-Clarity Act losses and pushing 2026 flows back into positive territory.

items.title: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
items.summary: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves. Will it be enough?

items.title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
items.summary: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.

items.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
items.summary: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.

items.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
items.summary: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

items.title: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
items.summary: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.

items.title: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
items.summary: A flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 put old Magic Eden Ethereum listings at risk, prompting a whitehat rescue of more than 23,000 NFTs.

items.title: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Holds Bitcoin in a Coinbase Wallet, Filing Shows
items.summary: Two entries in his annual disclosure put the holding somewhere between $16,000 and $65,000, alongside more than $1 million in cash.

items.title: Justice Department Holds the First Attorney General’s Summit on Victims of Violent Crime
items.summary: On Thursday, the Attorney General gathered victims and survivor families together at the first Summit on Victims of Violent Crime ahead of National Day of Remembrance for Murder Victims on September 25.

items.title: Researchers Publish 'Zcash-Style' Design for Private Bitcoin Transfers
items.summary: The Shielded Bitcoin spec hides senders, receivers and amounts, but leaves how BTC enters and exits the system to a later paper.

items.title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
items.summary: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.

items.title: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets

items.title: In Her Final Weeks, SEC's Peirce Calls for Ending the KYC 'Panopticon'
items.summary: In one of her final speeches as commissioner, Peirce argued that regulators' "data haystacks" endanger the people they aim to protect—as recent KYC leaks expose crypto holders to phishing and physical attacks.

items.title: US Aims to Turn Stablecoins Into a Weapon for Dollar Dominance
items.summary: Washington may fund private stablecoin ventures abroad to protect the dollar's reserve status and prop up Treasury demand.

items.title: Bitcoin Breakout Cools as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Climb
items.summary: Bitcoin has slipped back below $85,000 after tagging an eight-month high near $87,400 last week, with rising odds of an October Fed hike taking some air out of the rally.

items.title: £10K Reward Offered After UK Couple Attacked in Crypto Home Invasion
items.summary: Police believe the robbery was planned and targeted, with instructions relayed to the three attackers by a fourth man on a video call.

items.title: Solana Foundation Hires Binance's Former Global CMO for Institutional Push
items.summary: Rachel Conlan arrives as chief strategy officer and Polygon Labs' Jamal Raees takes over payments, both recruited from elsewhere in crypto.

items.title: Elliptic Wants Every Cop to Read a Crypto Wallet in Seconds—With AI
items.summary: Elliptic’s new AI-assisted tool, called Pulse, lets any officer input a wallet address or transaction hash and get a plain-language summary in seconds, aiming to bring crypto tracing beyond specialized units.

items.title: Morning Minute: Selig Says ‘It’s Go Time’ for CFTC Crypto Rules
items.summary: The CFTC has been extremely busy ever since the Clarity Act failed its vote, and it appears they’re ready to accelerate.

items.title: Brooklyn Man Who Bragged About $16M Coinbase Scam Gets Up to 12 Years
items.summary: He posed as support staff, emptied about 100 accounts, then lost $6 million of the proceeds gambling, according to his own messages.

items.title: $15.6 Billion in Bitcoin Options Expire Friday—Here's What It Means
items.summary: Deribit's strike-by-strike data shows a book stacked with calls, and one price level drawing hedging pressure from both sides at once.

items.title: Borrow Against Your Bitcoin at a Fixed Rate: Coinbase Expands Morpho Loans
items.summary: The product lets users lock in their rate and repayment date when borrowing USDC against Bitcoin, marking the first enterprise-scale deployment of Morpho Midnight and a shift away from on-chain lending's variable-rate norm.
